accountId.title: accountId
accountId.description: Salesforce Account Id of the current UI customer used as the anchor for retrieving insights; it is not a business customer number and is only used for CRM lookup and relationship resolution.

scope.title: scope
scope.description: Determines execution mode: SINGLE = only current UI customer; PORTFOLIO = all related customers under CPID; must be derived from user intent before invoking the action.
